resources.string: Reads the text shown by the system Live Caption for instant translation. Nothing is collected or uploaded.

How it works: reads the system Live Caption text via an accessibility service — no screenshots, no screen-recording permission.

Prerequisite: your phone's built-in Live Caption is turned on.

Quick tile: pull down Quick Settings → edit → drag the "Live Caption Translator" tile up, then tap once to toggle.

Can't enable accessibility? Long-press the app icon on the home screen → App info → ⋮ menu → "Allow restricted settings", then try again.
Show recognized source text in overlay (debug)
Classic machine translation: simplest setup, fastest, average quality, free for personal use
Dedicated MT model: best overall experience, paid after free quota (¥0.6 / ¥1.6 per million chars)
General-purpose LLM: best comprehension, but slower
Alibaba Cloud Bailian API Key (bailian.console.aliyun.com → API-KEY)

【Step 1: pick an engine & enter its key】 (at the top of this page)

• Baidu Translate API (default, fastest)
Sign up: https://fanyi-api.baidu.com
Developer console → text translation → get APPID & key. Free for personal use.

• Qwen-MT-Lite (dedicated MT model, best overall)
Sign up: https://bailian.console.aliyun.com
Create a key on the API-KEY page. Free quota for new users; paid afterwards (¥0.6 / ¥1.6 per million chars).

• DeepSeek (general LLM, strongest comprehension but slower)
Sign up: https://platform.deepseek.com
Create a key on the API keys page. Billed per token, top-up required.

【Step 2: two system switches】
• Overlay permission: tap ① on the home screen and enable this app
• Accessibility: tap ②, find "Live Caption Translator" under installed services and enable it
• If the toggle is blocked (Restricted settings): Settings → Apps → this app → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then retry

【Step 3: turn on Live Caption】
While a video plays, press a volume key and tap the "Live Caption" icon below the volume panel; if not found, go to Settings → Accessibility → Hearing enhancements → Live Caption. The system then shows captions for the audio.

【Step 4: start】
Back on the home screen tap "③ Start translating" — the overlay appears immediately. Add the Quick Settings tile for one-tap toggling.

【FAQ】
Q: Overlay shows but never translates?
A: Make sure system Live Caption is actually showing foreign subtitles; increase "Trailing caption lines to read".

Q: Translation shows a key error?
A: Key missing or wrong — recheck it here; DeepSeek also needs account balance.

Q: Does it work with Netflix/Disney+?
A: Yes. The app reads the caption TEXT, not the screen — DRM screenshot limits don't apply.

Version: Live Caption Translator v1.8 · open source & auditable
